usage: Evaluation only. Do not send this file, its labels, or its outcome URLs to the model.
semantic_label_policy: Researcher-specified expectations based on supplied economic claims. They describe conditional business channels, not guaranteed stock returns. They were recorded before pilot inference, but the researcher knew the famous historical outcomes.
market_label_policy: Next regular-session close-to-close percentage changes as rounded in contemporaneous reporting, not independent price-data calculations. The preceding close predates each after-hours issuer release. Benchmark subtraction would be simple market adjustment, not a causal estimate or beta-adjusted abnormal return.
limitations: Three selected extreme events are a smoke test, not a representative sample.
Historical model training may include these famous outcomes, even if outcome text is excluded from prompts.
Researcher-curated short summaries bypass full-stream retrieval, article extraction and event selection.
Other news and market conditions also influenced each next-session return.
